items.title: Prepare fewer portions of all dishes on Fridays at dinner
items.description: Unsold share was 30% versus 20% in comparable services (+10.0 pp over 12 days). Try a lower planned quantity and check it in the simulator before changing the plan.

limitations: Opportunities are indicative and are not guaranteed savings.
